data.exact_reserve_text: The loss on the technical account of GBP 23.6m (2016: profit GBP 21.4m) includes a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m for prior accident years (2016: GBP 21.5m surplus). This included a deficit of GBP 8.8m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 0.8m on direct business (2016: surplus of GBP 5.5m for reinsurance acceptance business and a surplus of GBP 16.0m on direct business).

named_events.loss_description: Significant catastrophe activity in 2017; Industry Loss Warranties became payable as a result of these hurricanes, driving large recoveries.
Significant catastrophe activity in 2017; contributed to industry loss warranty recoveries and increased US situs funding requirements.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (liabilities) were GBP 553.084m. Using the published gross claims development triangle, the syndicate shows net adverse prior-year development (gross) of approximately GBP 9.15m (about 1.7% of opening reserves), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The managing agent separately describes a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m for prior accident years (noting a GBP 8.8m deficit for reinsurance acceptance business and a GBP 0.8m surplus on direct business). The movement appears to be driven by adverse development on older underwriting years (notably 2015 and earlier) and is reported alongside significant 2017 catastrophe activity (Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and the California wildfires) which affected overall results and reinsurance/ILW recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: the managing agent narrative states a run-off deficit of GBP 8.0m (with an GBP 8.8m deficit on reinsurance acceptances and a GBP 0.8m surplus on direct business) but does not explicitly state whether that GBP 8.0m is gross or net. A gross calculation was performed using the published gross claims development triangle (claims amounts are printed in GBP '000s) which yields an aggregate gross adverse movement of approximately GBP 9.151m for underwriting years 2015. The reported narrative figure appears to be a net-style summary; therefore the triangle-derived gross figure has been used as the primary prior_year_development_gbp_m (confidence 0.8). Opening gross claims outstanding was taken from the comparative balance sheet (explicit).
